notes.title: Nachkriegsratten New Album News - 2024 💿🗞️
notes.content:
Merkel, Merkel, Merkel!

The post-war rats are cheerfully tinkering with the new album when suddenly, singer Culti notices that Wännerwann has swapped all the Ws and Ms. Of course, they don’t notice! They are working! And they are working on the new album. Behind "Wännerwann" hides none other than the taciturn, uh, rather word-shy guitarist of the rat pack: Männermann.

Good heavens, that was a close call! Blissfully, they fall into each other's arms after solving this tricky case of word mix-up. The world could not be more beautiful.

But suddenly, a brown wind blows into the rat hole. Could it be the old spirit of the German Wehrmacht returning? Wasn't it promised to us that we had learned something from history? Don’t they always pride themselves with the call: 

NEVER AGAIN FASCISM?

The post-war rats know it’s time to take action. They nod to each other. Pissed off, they reach for their frying pans. With a grim smile, Culti opens the door.

"Time to whack the brown plague over the head."

notes.title: Small Patch 🩹 + new music video 🎵🎥
notes.content:
Hello fellow rats,

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/hergorntv]HergornTV [/url] played our life negating game and found some things he'd like to had changed, so we did.

Unlocked Text Book pages are now easier to understand that they are actually clickable.
The game now runs in background, allowing the beautiful music to play while you do other things on your computer.
Also changed the link to [url=https://bomb-all.com/Vorverkauf/NACHKRIEGSRATTEN-Sack-LP-T-Shirt-Kram::937.html]Bomb All Records[/url] for a search page, in case the LP gets sold out again.

notes.title: HOTFIX - 1.0.13 🩹
notes.content:
Hi punks,

sadly there were a BUG in Picture 7 "Aufstand der Ratten" where it could not be solved at sizes 400 (just sometimes) and 625.
This update solves that problem.

Great thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/deborah/]deborah[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198308763189]omy_4[/url] for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1887050/discussions/0/3775742015029655544/]reporting this issue[/url], so I could solve it for the good of all of us 💖.

While I was at it, I decreased the victory sound volume a bit and did a bit of cleanup, making our unlovely game a bit smaller in size and faster in loading.

Again sorry for the inconvenience.

HAPPY PUNKING
